title: Erdős problem #1020: matching extremal hypergraph
statement: For r≥3 and n≥rk, the maximum size of an r-uniform n-vertex hypergraph with matching number below k is max(C(rk−1,r), C(n,r)−C(n−k+1,r)).

counterexample.description: Parameters r,n,k and an r-uniform hypergraph exceeding the stated bound while having no k pairwise disjoint edges.

status_observation.note: A February 2026 preprint claims a complete proof. Later 2026 specialist work still treats the conjecture as unresolved, so its exact status requires independent review.
